summary:
Hector Salas is undercity mechanic who panics last and hides people between jobs. The life that shows in public is anchored at Undercity bay, Ring C. Hector keeps the undercity repair bay running after the advertised night shift has been cut. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Handy, loyal, and hard to panic. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they measure every guest against the one guest they failed so every new guest is a test they hate administering. If that truth surfaces at Undercity bay, Ring C, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
